questions.learningObjective: judge whether drafts terminate correctly
questions.stem: During weekend tutoring, a mentor pins four trial methods to the board and asks which ones terminate correctly for every non-negative input. Which methods are correct? Select all that apply.

options.text: Countdown with base n <= 0 that calls itself on n - 1.
String measure with empty-string base that recurses on substring(1).
Total with no base case that always calls itself on n - 1.
Climb with base n == 0 that calls itself on n + 1.

questions.explanation: Correct recursion pairs a reachable base with a strictly shrinking argument; missing bases and growing arguments never land.
questions.hint: Check each draft for a reachable stop and shrinking input.

questions.stem: A gardener's recursive harvester handles row n by first handling row n - 1. Which design rule keeps it from running forever?

options.text: Each call must move strictly closer to the base case.

questions.explanation: Termination comes from shrinking distance to a reachable base, not from output, names, or speed.
questions.hint: Ask what must shrink on every call.
